Usage

When to use. The scrollbar appears automatically on any surface whose content overflows. It is a passive overlay affordance — thin and unobtrusive at rest, widening on hover so it is easy to grab. Never add explicit scroll arrows or a solid track.

Do

  • Keep the thumb tertiary (#6f6f6f) with a circular (pill) radius.
  • Rest at 2px and widen to 6px on hover.
  • Align the thumb to the end edge over a transparent track.
  • Let overflow drive visibility — hide it when content fits.

Don't

  • Add a filled track, borders, or scroll-arrow buttons.
  • Reserve permanent gutter space that shifts the layout.
  • Recolor the thumb per surface — keep it neutral tertiary.
  • Use it as a progress or range indicator.
